constraints: Company records stay in this company repository
Preserve signed/allowlisted Slack ingress, typed proposals and exact-candidate approval
Existing subscription models and bounded maintenance engine; no research execution or external deployment in this slice
Real PostgreSQL/Temporal checks; label simulated Slack/Codex separately

deliverables.description: Complete company channel structure and staged employee activation
acceptance: Seven core channels, three feeds, social/test and gated risk-desk are documented
data-watch whole inventory plus core detail is explicitly the next implementation

deliverables.description: Dedicated improvements intake, durable case threads and independent reporting
acceptance: Configured Maintainer identity receives dedicated-channel conversations without duplicate director work
New cases preserve owner/source linkage and report to a stable thread with case cards
Progress reporting continues independently of long maintenance calls
Existing cases and exact-head approval remain compatible
Real PostgreSQL tests cover ingress, owner scope, case delivery and approval
Real Temporal validates independent reporting and history replay
Repository tests and lint pass; live activation gaps are explicitly recorded

nonGoals: Implement later-stage data-watch, briefing or risk engines in the first slice
Change other worktrees or research repositories
Deploy or post test messages to production Slack
outcome: Implement the plan. AI 직원 회사 Slack 전체 채널 설계를 회사 저장소에 반영하고, 합의한 첫 구현 범위인 전용 Maintainer와 improvements 채널의 접수·케이스 스레드·독립 상태 보고·기존 승인 경로를 구현하고 검증한다. data-watch를 다음 구현으로 명시하고 나머지 채널과 직원 활성화 조건을 보존한다.
